criteria.description: Bus interface signals comply with standard protocols (AXI/AHB/APB); verify VALID/READY handshake invariants, burst boundaries, and response channels without deadlock risk; cite protocol assertions or state machine transitions.
Bandwidth allocation, arbitration schemes, and FIFO depth sizing guarantee real-time latency budgets under peak load; cite arbitration weights and queue definitions.
Memory hierarchy maintains cache coherency across master agents; verify barrier semantics, snooping filter integrity, and memory ordering models; cite coherency port bindings.
Multi-voltage domain interfaces verify UPF/CPF isolation rules, level-shifter insertions, and safe power-up/down reset sequencing; cite power controller control sequences.
